submission_method: Submit one (1) PDF copy of the proposal, clearly identified with the RFP number, title and the name of the Proponent, via the City's online bidding system portal at https://medicinehat.bidsandtenders.ca/Module
contract_term: The term of the agreement is to be for a period of five (5) years, with an option in favour of the City to extend the agreement on the same terms and conditions annually for an additional two (2) years.
scope_of_deliverables: Provide a modern, user-friendly, and secure Corporate Learning Management System (LMS) to support corporate training, onboarding, compliance, safety, professional development, and certification tracking for employees, volunteers, and other external learners.
mandatory_submission_requirements: Submission Form (Appendix B), Pricing (Appendix C), Vendor's agreement, Transmittal Letter, Proponent Qualifications, Resumes, and Relevant Experience, Letters of reference, and acknowledgement of receipt of any RFP Addenda.
mandatory_technical_requirements: Valid City of Medicine Hat Business License, Cybersecurity Vendor Assessment (CVA), and compliance with all mandatory technical requirements set out in Appendix D (RFP Particulars), Section E.
evaluation_criteria: Stage I: Technical Capability (50 points, minimum 35 to proceed); Stage II: Product Demonstration (30 points); Stage III: Vendor Experience & References (15 points), Implementation & Support (20 points), and Pricing (15 points). Total points: 130.
minimum_score_threshold: Proponents must achieve a minimum technical score of 35 out of 50 points to meet the technical threshold and proceed to the next stage.
pricing_requirements: Rates must be provided in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes except for GST, which should be itemized separately. Proponents must clearly separate one-time implementation costs from annual recurring costs.
minimum_insurance_requirements: Commercial General Liability ($2,000,000.00 per occurrence), Employer's liability ($2,000,000.00 per employee), Professional Errors and Omissions Liability ($1,000,000.00 per claim), Cyber Liability ($2,000,000.00 per occurrence), and Automobile Liability ($2,000,000.00 per occurrence).
vendor_experience_qualifications: Relevant LMS experience: years providing this service, implementations, Municipal/government implementations, references similar in scope & size over last 5 years (minimum of 3), roles & responsibilities – both the implementation & support teams' resumes that will be assigned to this project.
number_of_references_required: Minimum of 3 references similar in scope & size over last 5 years.
data_security_privacy_requirements: Compliance with industry security best practices (SOC2, ISO, etc.), PIPA Compliance, Incident Response Plan, data encryption at rest and in transit, and a Business Continuity Plan.
data_hosting_residency_requirements: Vendor server preferred within Canada to comply with PIPA; option for cloud storage in Canada or on-premises storage.
vendor_demonstration_requirement: Product demonstration in two stages: Stage 1 technical evaluation (50 points) and Stage 2 demo evaluation (30 points) for up to six top-ranked proponents.
